categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Cotran New Material Co., Ltd. primarily operates in two main business segments: polymer materials and thermal management systems. The polymer materials segment focuses on high-performance specialty rubber products including waterproof sealing materials, fireproof insulation materials, and automotive sealing strips. The thermal management systems segment produces heat dissipation metal structural parts such as liquid cooling plates for new energy vehicles and energy storage systems, as well as cooling components for traditional home appliances and data centers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary formulations and advanced manufacturing processes for high-performance specialty rubber materials, including cold shrink tubing and fireproof sealing products. In thermal management, it employs fluid dynamics, flow channel design, and thermal simulation technologies to develop liquid cooling plates and heat dissipation modules. The company also invests in automation and process optimization to improve production efficiency and product quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major telecommunications equipment manufacturers such as Huawei, ZTE, and Ericsson, as well as telecom operators like China Mobile, China Telecom, and China Unicom. In the power sector, customers include State Grid, Southern Power Grid, and Thailand Power Grid. Automotive clients include Chery and Geely. The company also serves leading new energy battery manufacturers like CATL and Hive Energy, and home appliance brands such as Haier. Markets served span telecommunications, power, automotive, new energy, traditional home appliances, and data centers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant sales in Northeast, North, East, South, Central, Northwest, and Southwest China regions. It also has overseas business contributing over 6% of revenue, with expanding international market presence. Subsidiaries and production facilities are located in Shenzhen, Suzhou, Wuxi, Wuhu, Dongguan, and Hong Kong.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shenzhen Cotran New Material Co., Ltd. operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It manufactures high-performance polymer materials and thermal management components that are supplied to equipment manufacturers and system integrators in telecommunications, power, automotive, and new energy sectors. The company also provides integrated solutions, indicating involvement in product design and development beyond pure manufacturing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in integrated waterproof sealing products for 5G and industrial IoT applications, inorganic intumescent fireproof particles, and high-performance sealing tapes. It invests in developing advanced thermal management solutions for new energy vehicles and data centers, including liquid cooling plates and immersion cooling systems. R&D efforts focus on product integration, performance optimization, cost reduction, and expanding application scenarios in emerging industries such as AI and digital infrastructure.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of high-performance specialty rubber materials and thermal management system components. The company sells directly and through distributors, with a majority of sales via direct channels. Pricing is influenced by raw material costs and market demand, and the company also receives government subsidies and investment income as supplementary revenue sources.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a strong position in the domestic high-performance polymer materials and thermal management sectors, recognized for technological leadership and quality. It faces competition in high-voltage cable accessories and liquid cooling plates, where market concentration and technological barriers exist. The company competes with leading domestic and international suppliers in telecommunications, power, automotive, and new energy industries, leveraging its R&D capabilities and strategic customer partnerships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 958 million, representing a 71.53% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 17.28 million, a decrease of 32.12% mainly due to reduced government subsidies and investment income. The company maintains a robust growth trajectory driven by market expansion and technological upgrades, with significant investments in capacity expansion and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its strong R&D capabilities, proprietary technology, and integrated product solutions tailored to customer needs in strategic industries. It offers high-quality, reliable, and innovative polymer materials and thermal management products with superior performance in waterproofing, fireproofing, insulation, and heat dissipation. Close collaboration with major clients enables rapid product development and customization, enhancing customer value and competitive differentiation.
